info.name: Adyen Get a List of Merchant Accounts

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: The number of the page to fetch.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of items to have on a page, maximum 100. The default is 10 items on a page.

items.docs:
Returns the list of merchant accounts that your API credential has access to. The list is grouped into pages as defined by the query parameters. 

To make this request, your API credential must have the following [roles](https://docs.adyen.com/development-resources/api-credentials#api-permissions):
* Management API—Account read

Use this endpoint if your integration requires it, such as Adyen for Platforms Manage. Your Adyen contact will set up your access.

To make this request, your API credential must have the following [roles](https://docs.adyen.com/development-resources/api-credentials#api-permissions):
* Management API—Account read
